title: RaFL: An Empirical Study of Random Filter Losses for Image Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2611.17707v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pixel losses train image reconstruction networks toward a point statistic of the target distribution, often averaging away fine textures under uncertainty. Perceptual losses alleviate this issue using pretrained features, but those features are inherently domain-specific. We study a random filter loss (RaFL) that compares prediction and target through filters with random weights, avoiding both pretrained features and task-specific loss engineering. RaFL combines random convolutions, random Fourier features, and random wavelet filters, automatically balancing their contributions through gradient-norm matching, eliminating manual loss-weight tuning and grid search. We systematically investigate three design choices: filter family, weight resampling schedule, and weight initialization. translated_title: RaFL：用于图像重建的随机滤波器损失的实证研究
translated_abstract: 像素损失在训练图像重建网络时，会使网络趋向目标分布的一个点统计量，在存在不确定性时往往会把精细纹理平均掉。感知损失通过预训练特征缓解了这一问题，但这些特征本质上是与特定领域绑定的。我们研究了一种随机滤波器损失，它通过具有随机权重的滤波器来比较预测结果与目标，从而既避免了使用预训练特征，也避免了针对具体任务的损失函数设计工作。RaFL 结合了随机卷积、随机傅里叶特征和随机小波滤波器，并通过梯度范数匹配自动平衡三者的贡献，无需手动调整损失权重或进行网格搜索。我们系统地研究了三种设计选择：滤波器族、权重重采样策略和权重初始化方式。基于验证集 PSNR 以及跨随机种子的稳定性，我们选择了同时使用三种滤波器族、并在每次优化（迭代）时重新抽取滤波器权重的配置……
tldr: 提出了一种无需预训练特征和人工调参的随机滤波器损失，通过随机卷积、随机傅里叶特征和随机小波滤波器结合梯度范数匹配自动平衡各滤波器的贡献，有效提升图像重建中精细纹理的保留效果。
en_tdlr: RaFL is a random filter loss for image reconstruction that compares predictions and targets through random convolutions, random Fourier features, and random wavelet filters, automatically balancing their contributions via gradient-norm matching without requiring pretrained features or manual loss-weight tuning.
